svg.title: dnachem-min: application workflow and Geant4 kernel interaction
svg.desc: Swimlane workflow of the dnachem-min Geant4-DNA application: startup, initialization, the per-event loop (physical stage, chemistry stage, scoring) and the end-of-run dump, showing which project classes plug into which Geant4 kernel components and who calls whom.
svg.text: dnachem-min workflow: how the application and the Geant4 kernel interlace
Geant4 owns the control flow. The project supplies classes that plug into Geant4 base classes, and the kernel calls them back (red dashed arrows).
